items.text: Ticket 77120: supplier invoice INV-2291 from Harrowgate Supplies arrived with the wrong billing address; the accounts team needs the corrected copy, and they mentioned their chatbot couldn't find the PDF we uploaded last week.

We're finalising the seating plan for the Alvarez–Whitfield wedding on 6 September and need the place cards (120 of them, navy ink) delivered to the Riverside Barn address, not the billing address, by 25 August. The order notes currently show the billing address because I copied it from the invoice by mistake. If the automated confirmation says 'delivery scheduled', it's only for the billing address, so please don't treat it as final. I've attached the venue's delivery instructions from their events coordinator. Could you update the shipping details and confirm the new date in writing? Thanks — Priya at Everly Events.

intent.requested_action: update shipping address and confirm new delivery date

items.text: Hi team, regarding ticket 88941: the school's purchase order for the trip kit (item SKU 5510-3, 30 units) was raised under the district's central account, so the invoice should show that reference rather than the individual school's. Our finance office flagged that the current invoice lists a different PO number, and they need a corrected copy before the end of term. Also, the packing slip you sent refers to 'field trip supplies' generally, and the school wants the specific item list included for the audit trail. I've attached the original PO and the packing slip scan. Please reissue the invoice with the correct reference and send the itemised version to accounts@northvale-district.example.org. Best, Dana.

items.text: Recording for ticket 90456: Mrs. Okafor called about her order for the school trip first-aid kits. She said the web chat bot promised her a discount code, but she never received it and the code isn't in her account. She also noted that the checkout page's confirmation email got caught in her spam filter, so she missed the pickup window. She's not asking for anything unusual—just the code applied if it was authorised, and the kits held at the store until Friday. I've noted her contact details in the record. She mentioned she'd rather deal with a person from now on because the bot kept misunderstanding her postcode. Please follow up before Thursday.

items.text: We're preparing the supplier invoice for the Springdale Academy trip and need your AP team to confirm the remit-to details. Our records show an old account number from before the bank merger, and our finance director has asked that the new details be sent on letterhead with a signed authorisation. The invoice itself lists the trip as 'educational services — residential', which the school's bursar wants clarified as covering transport, meals and two nights' accommodation. The supplier reference on the invoice is wrong too: it shows our old trading name, which the school's system won't match. Could you reissue the invoice with the correct reference and bank details, and send a short note explaining the change? The bursar's PA is coordinating from the school side and has the original PO on file.

intent.requested_action: reissue the invoice with corrected reference and bank details

items.text: Query about wedding order #77120 (Linens): The table runners arrived with a print error, and the couple's planner is asking for replacements before 2 August. I looked at the order history and noticed the address was updated by a chat assistant during checkout last month, which is why the first delivery went to the old flat. The runner pattern is 'wildflower sage', and the order confirmation shows 30 runners, but only 24 arrived. The planner has photos of the error and the packing list. We need to know whether the missing six were shipped separately or need to be reordered, and whether the delivery address update was actually saved. Please check with the warehouse and reply to the planner, cc me.

intent.requested_action: check missing runners and confirm whether the address update was saved

items.text: Follow-up on supplier invoice 2291 (Harrowgate Supplies): The invoice PDF includes a note that the pricing on the trip first-aid kits reflects a bulk discount that expires at the end of the quarter, and our buyer wants to lock in the price for the autumn term. The invoice also has a 'confidential' stamp on the pricing schedule, which is standard for this supplier, so no action needed on that front. However, the PO number on the invoice is for a different school, which we think is a template error on the supplier's side. We've asked the supplier to confirm the correct PO and to extend the quoted price to the autumn order. Could you update our records with the supplier's confirmation once it arrives and flag the invoice for approval? The buyer is on leave until Monday, so there's no rush before then.
